subject: Mental Models
title: Linear vs Nonlinear Systems
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Linear vs Nonlinear Systems.

hook.text: Double the dose of medicine and you might not get double the effect. You might get a toxic reaction instead.

buildup.text: Linear systems have proportional inputs and outputs. Nonlinear systems can produce wildly disproportionate results.

twist.text: People default to linear thinking. They expect double effort to yield double results. Reality rarely cooperates.

climax.text: Ask: is the relationship proportional or not? If nonlinear.

punchline.text: Not all inputs scale equally. Find the nonlinear levers.

quiz.question: Why is linear thinking misleading in most real-world systems?
options: Most real systems are nonlinear, so double input rarely means double output
